column1: # f70_partition.tsv - D14's boundary, in the one form that can be vetoed.
# D14 [vixy 2026-08-31]: "Every source file must be in ASCII, accents are to be
# removed for this purpose."  Its boundary clause is [derived, veto-open]:
# "source file" = files whose bytes are read by humans and compilers, NOT files
# whose non-ASCII bytes are their FUNCTION.  This table IS that clause's
# challengeable form: every EXCLUDE row carries a one-line reason, and the rule
# applied throughout is "in doubt => EXCLUDE + flag, never silent conversion".
#   pathspec  an exact tracked path, or a prefix ending in '/'
#   matching  LONGEST pathspec wins, so an EXCLUDE island inside a CONVERT
#             subtree is one reviewable row rather than a hidden special case.
# CONVERT means: the transliteration map is applied AND f70_ascii.py's gate
# asserts ZERO non-ASCII bytes afterwards.  EXCLUDE means: not one byte touched.
# The table covers the WHOLE tree, not only today's non-ASCII files: the gate
# fails on any non-ASCII file matching no row, so a future file cannot slip in
# unclassified.  That is why CONVERT rows name whole subtrees.
# The engine and everything first-party that compiles, builds or is read as code.
